2026_04_ATL_NO.headline: Penix and Atlanta’s pressure front meet Shough’s high-volume Saints attack under the Dome lights
2026_04_ATL_NO.paragraph1: Atlanta enters the Superdome with Michael Penix Jr. coming off a sharp return in Green Bay, while Bijan Robinson and Drake London give the Falcons multiple ways to stress New Orleans. The Saints counter with Tyler Shough, who entered Week 4 among the league leaders in passing yards, and Chris Olave atop a high-volume passing game. The matchup may turn on protection: Jeff Ulbrich’s Falcons have generated consistent quarterback pressure while New Orleans tries to keep Shough on schedule.
2026_04_ATL_NO.model_rationale: Atlanta’s pressure and balanced skill group create multiple stress points, while New Orleans can answer by protecting Shough and sustaining its aggressive, pass-driven offensive rhythm.
